ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black pixels (~80%) interspersed with high-intensity light-grey and white pixels (~20%) forming circular clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white/grey annular rings (rosettes) are distributed across the visible black surface. A higher concentration of grey pixels is mapped to the lower-proximal region of the left lobe near the water line.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with acute angularity; the exact apex is obscured by the water surface, but the visible interior walls converge sharply.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible on the right lobe trailing edge, characterized by significant pixel-amplitude spikes due to attached calcified organisms (barnacles).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The right lobe exhibits a strong convex sweep terminating in a tapered tip; the left lobe trajectory is partially obscured by water and motion blur.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive detection of circular, high-contrast pixel rings (white on black) across the medial and lateral surfaces of both lobes, consistent with old barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned vertical linear pixel disruptions visible on the upper portion of the left lobe's ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy colonization by protruding white calcified clusters (barnacles) along the distal margins and tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique density of 'ghost' ring patterns (concentric scarring) covering a majority of the visible ventral pigmentation.
